topics: Quality of life considerations related to ICDs
Economic evaluations of ICDs in various patient populations
Clinical guidelines for ICD implantation and management
key_points: The cost-effectiveness of ICDs is evaluated in different contexts and patient groups.
Quality of life assessments are part of the evaluation of ICDs.
Numerous studies have examined the economic and clinical implications of ICD use in specific medical scenarios, such as heart failure and myocardial infarction.
